specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PRODUCTION TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas for original TAN NGUYET top-down3/4 pixel RPG, using the supplied B2 character DESIGN reference for identity/quality. NOT a review board: NO text, NO grid lines, NO background, NO cast floor/shadow. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY. One sprite sheet exactly EIGHT COLUMNS by TWELVE ROWS, NINETY-SIX full-body sprites. Equal rectangular cells, constant center/feet baseline per cell, transparent gutters. Tall canvas approximately1536x2304. Each body designed for native32x42: sharp pixel clusters and 1-pixel native outline, limited palette; detailed face and shaped cloth, no tiny decorative noise, no smoothpainting, no blur, no antialiasing. Consistent lighttop-left and top-down3/4 camera.
ONE same race/identity across all96sprites, never fourraces in same atlas. UNARMED body with ordinary linen tunic, olive-green cloth #5B8B54/#294C3D, brown belt/boots, natural skin #E1BB96/#C89E7C, brown hair #AE7548/#674533. NO weapons, armor, staff, special gear, effects, bags obscuring body. Class equipment and appearance are separate game layers, do NOT bake equipment into base. Preserve ears/beard/muzzle/tail characteridentity across every direction andpose.
STRICT layout mapping (zero-basedrows):
Rows0+1 IDLE; rows2+3 WALK; rows4+5 ATTACK gesture; rows6+7 HURT; rows8+9 DEATH; rows10+11 DODGE.
For EVERY evenrow of a state: columns0,1,2,3 = DOWN-facing animationframes1,2,3,4; columns4,5,6,7 = LEFT-facing frames1,2,3,4.
For EVERY oddrow of that same state: columns0,1,2,3 = RIGHT-facing frames1,2,3,4; columns4,5,6,7 = UP/back-facing frames1,2,3,4.
Actual down/front, left/rightprofile, up/back NEVER showfrontface inbackview. Do not arbitrarily mirror the same direction. Four consecutive actionframes per direction:
IDLE subtle breathingcloth/hair variations.
WALK leftstep, passing, rightstep, passing, clear leg/arm cycle.
ATTACK unarmed anticipation, extending leading hand, followthrough, recover (weapons added by game).
HURT braceimpact, recoil, bend, recover.
DEATH stagger, kneesbuckle, sidewaysfall, finally fullyhorizontal collapsed body. In all4directions, final is LYING, notkneeling. Keepdeath body compact foreshortened within native32pxwidth; no gore/disappearance.
DODGE lowcrouch, sidewayspushoff, lowglide, recover. No teleporting/flying, no effects.
All96cells filled once, aligned equal grid, entire head/ears/tail/hands/feet fully within eachcell, generous blankgutters, constant scale per race, no merging cells. No text/labels/logos/watermark, 3D/animepainting, smoothgradients, externalcharacters or modernclothes.
